jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(1)(C) inventory: South Hero School District, a town school district in the Grand Isle Supervisory Union (member town: South Hero) -- listed separately from the Champlain Islands UUSD; it kept its own town board. Operates K-8 (Folsom); tuitions grades 9-12.
Folsom Education & Community Center / South Hero School District (official site).

board.post_note: South Hero SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b), elected by Australian ballot with per-seat term lengths on the ballot. One seat is in an interim-appointment window to March 2027; the appointee's membership is held (see the sources).

sources.note: South Hero certified Official Return of Votes, school election March 3, 2026 (Town Clerk Naomi S. King): "SCHOOL DIRECTOR - 2 YEARS: RICHARD MONTEROSSO 460"; "SCHOOL DIRECTOR - 3 YEARS: ERIC HAMMOND 440." The 2025 town report abstract records Kathryn "Kaight" Althoff elected in March 2025 to a 2-year term (end 2027) and Timothy Maxham to a 3-year term (to 2028). Maxham's seat fell vacant effective August 1, 2026 -- the board's vacancy notice (Folsom board page) seeks an interim appointee "until March, 2027," when voters will elect a director for the final year of the term ending March 2028; Maxham is recorded ended 2026. Anna Bedard appears as the fifth name on the district's current-members list but NO fetched document names her appointment -- her membership is HELD (resolving document: the board's Aug./Sept. 2026 appointment minutes). Whitney Doremus (Vice Chair) is an incumbent since at least the March 2023 reorganization; no term end is published for her in any fetched source. UPDATE 2026-10-28: Bedard is now minted APPOINTED with her end held (GISU roster sheet; March-vs-May 2027 conflict disclosed in her membership sources), and Doremus's end is set to '2027' from the same sheet. The board is 5 of 5 seated (Maxham recorded ended 2026).

directors.name: Eric Hammond
directors.note: Elected March 3, 2026 to a 3-year term (certified return: 440 votes).

directors.name: Kathryn Althoff
directors.note: Ballot name Kathryn "Kaight" Althoff; elected March 2025 to a 2-year term (2025 town report abstract: 599 votes).

directors.name: Whitney Doremus
directors.note: Vice Chair; incumbent since at least March 2023; term end '2027' per the GISU 2026-27 roster sheet.

sources.note: Grand Isle Supervisory Union, 'School Board Members - 26-27' roster sheet (official; supplied by Superintendent Lisa Ruud by email on 2026-10-28 in response to CivicMirror's records request for the Bedard appointment minutes -- the minutes themselves were not supplied): the South Hero section lists Anna Bedard, seated 2026, 'Expires May 2027', and the GISU board list annotates her '(replace Tim Maxham)'. Her mode is APPOINTED: Maxham's seat fell vacant effective August 1, 2026 and the board's vacancy notice filled it by interim appointment only, so no election could have seated her. Her END IS HELD: the vacancy notice runs the appointment to March 2027 (when voters elect a director for the final year of the term ending March 2028), while the GISU sheet says May 2027 -- the appointment minutes would settle it. The same sheet lists Whitney Doremus (Vice Chair) 'expires 2027', supplying the end our build lacked. The sheet's 'Year appointed' column is unreliable where it conflicts with certified returns (it dates Monterosso to 2023 against the certified March 2026 return) and is relied on here only for membership and expiries.

directors.name: Timothy Maxham
directors.note: Elected March 2025 to a 3-year term (2025 abstract: 621 votes); his seat fell vacant effective August 1, 2026 (the board's vacancy notice), to be filled by interim appointment to March 2027 and then by election for the final year to March 2028.
